audits.mechanism: The robustness function receives only IS-pass rows with a parsed submission check. IS failures and missing checks cannot enter its denominator, so upstream attrition can improve the displayed pass rate and change the verdict.

audits.rule: stop after five consecutive IS failures when any failure name appears at least three times
audits.mechanism: Later preregistered candidates are skipped rather than reported as tried outcomes. Ordering therefore changes which cells exist, and the negative cohort is censored by a private pre-gate.

data[param_name][str(param_value)] is assigned one metrics/result object. Re-use of the same value under another expression, field set, round or setting overwrites the prior observation and destroys context needed to separate parameter effects from candidate effects.

industry neutral field crowding short in: neutralize by MT5 asset class and currency-risk bucket

mt5_translation.methodology_analogue: Every candidate over every terminal-enumerated Fusion symbol must retain its full preregistered population, frozen expression/code/config/data identity and typed outcome. No IS-survivor-conditioned denominator and no last-write parameter aggregate may make a gate or research verdict.

source_formula_data_axes.instrument_scope: Fusion-listed US share CFDs only for the equity-specific fields; cross-asset operator methodology may span the contemporaneous terminal-enumerated universe
source_formula_data_axes.timeframe: D1, point-in-time as of the decision close; execution no earlier than the next available Fusion bid/ask
fusion_costs_required: overnight swap when held across rollover
source_formula_data_axes.point_in_time_constraints: terminal membership, corporate identifier, peer group, EPS vintage, short-volume publication timestamp and text/sentiment publication timestamp must all be known before signal time
source_formula_data_axes.verdict: DATA_GAP_AND_ORE_ONLY; no tradeable mechanism card raised

economic_disposition: Validated negative information: prevents a conditional-denominator false upgrade, censored trial history and overwritten sensitivity memory from entering the MT5 research system. Expected-log-wealth effect is positive but unmeasured; confidence high on the code-path findings and zero on the source alphas' MT5 profitability.
